name: axoloty
description: Collaborative IoT framework in Swift targeted at Apple, Linux and Embedded applications.

paragraphs: Development checkpoint. VERSION identifies the current published release (0.9.0). Axoloty is not API-stable. The 0.9 line moves to Swift 6.4, completes the split of firmware into phynics/axoloty-embedded, and adds an experimental Zenoh transport, on the versioned embedded consumer contract from 0.8 and the explicit runtime composition from 0.7.

Axoloty provides an application and communication layer foundation for collaborative IoT prosumer scenarios where smart agents act in an autonomous, collaborative, and ad-hoc fashion. Its key properties include:
features: a lightweight, modular, object-oriented software architecture favoring a
an immutable runtime definition and single-use AxolotyRuntime lifecycle,
standardized event-based communication patterns — Advertise / Deadvertise,
a fixed synchronous AxolotyStaticRuntime profile for Embedded Swift,
a platform-agnostic, extensible object model to discover, distribute, share,
